user_holds_ghybr_shares.meaning: user holds gHYBR shares obtained by depositing HYBR via GovernanceHYBR.deposit, with funds locked in the shared veNFT

withdrawal_completed.meaning: GovernanceHYBR.withdraw completes without a revert from VotingEscrow.multiSplit

withdrawal_fails.meaning: the revert from VotingEscrow.multiSplit propagates and the withdrawal fails, leaving the user unable to exit their position

assumptions: The user calls GovernanceHYBR.withdraw with all their shares (full exit).
The zero split leg is either remainingAmount or feeAmount; the report does not fix which in the observed case.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the zero leg forwarded to VotingEscrow.multiSplit is remainingAmount or feeAmount in the observed case; both are described as possible.
No concrete transaction or observed revert is supplied; the failure scenario is conditional on a zero remainder or zero fee.

limitations: Formalizes only the withdrawal_fails impact; other listed impacts are handled in separate passes.
The zero-leg numeric condition is not encoded as a P term because it is a root cause, not a BEFORE condition of the selected impact.
